<definition>

Compare the problem itself, not the product area. A spike that is unstarted or in progress is not shipped.

response.content: {"critique": "The problem is users struggling to upload and link documents to the correct reserves due to unclear guidance. The closest item, Shortcut #4127 'Bulk upload documents to a claim' (completed 2026-10-06), addresses uploading multiple documents to a claim but not linking them to the correct reserves or interface guidance for that process. The other items (activity timeline, claim information display, reporting navigation, claims timeline) address different problems entirely and none cover document-to-reserve linking. No shipped story or roadmap item solves this core problem.","verdict": "pass"}
